method: Independent review of complete worker packet and prior60 names/identities, with17 actual source-audit intervals for seven ambiguous organizations. Source packet facts are not falsely labeled as independently reopened. Additional primary search, opened pages and original PDF evidence are marked separately.
threshold: Discovery gate only: identifiable distinct organization, California activity and plausible health mechanism. Missing EIN, unmodeled returns, unknown room for funding or broad portfolio alone are not holds. Actual closed organization, wrong geography or unresolved organization-versus-sponsored-program scope would be held.
deduplicationScope: Compared initial20 and wave2 California names, available EINs, selected aliases and sponsor/affiliate evidence. No claim of exhaustive registry merger audit. Existing Bay/SF reports may overlap and are not new distinct organizations merely because this edition accepts them.
integrationWarnings: Use originalCandidateId to update existing provisional rows, not add40 extra rows.
MMH NOW exited Community Partners July1,2025 according to its own FY25 report. Do not hold using older sponsorship materials or assign Community Partners EIN to current independent organization.
Urban Peace Institute's current primary donation page names its own c3/EIN; its historical Community Partners affiliation is not a current entity hold.
Health Access Foundation c3 is accepted, not Health Access California c4. Walk San Francisco maps to Walk San Francisco Foundation.
BayLegal's health center serves nine counties while general organization description uses seven. Do not conflate Bay Area Legal Aid with Florida's Bay Area Legal Services.

Advance Peace is the organization, not each local fellowship or Richmond municipal Office of Neighborhood Safety. Later financial review should reconcile historical Safe Passages sponsorship and current legal perimeter.
Discovery acceptance must not be overwritten by subsequent lower comparative EV selection priority.
timeAccounting: 17 closed, actual per-organization source-audit intervals; source-packet comparison and synthesis outside these intervals are untimed. No division of batch wall time and no claimed complete coverage. Failed unsupported phase invocations created no sessions and are not counted.
